newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted mostly steady to lower on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted mostly steady to lower on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to lower levels in bids and offers on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus no barges traded on Wednesday.
- Two barges, this week or next week, lower Ohio River, bid 130 percent of tariff, no offer.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois River, no bid, offer 155 percent.
- Two barges, week of December 1, Illinois River, bid 145 percent, offer 155 percent.
- Five barges, one each week December, St Louis, Mississippi River, bid 100 percent, unchanged, similar, offer 105 percent.
- Five barges, one each week December, Ohio River, no bid, offer 130 percent, down five percentage points, similar.
